game_title: Phone Book Rescue – Avalanche Slope Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Frost Peaks – Avalanche Slope, a slope primed for avalanche: the rescue climber must handle ice hawks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Phone Book Rescue: Add and update dictionary entries as contacts change.
theme: Frost Peaks – Avalanche Slope: a slope primed for avalanche
core_gameplay_loop: In Avalanche Slope, repeat each round: Add and update dictionary entries as contacts change. Each round, ice hawks strike the rescue sled, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the contacts value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the rescue sled from ice hawks in Avalanche Slope: keep the contacts meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 71-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: contacts drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 71-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 8 (extended tier): Phone Book Rescue
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Phone Book Rescue' (Week 8 slot 8), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Avalanche Slope'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how contacts changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice hawks in Avalanche Slope.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 71 seconds while contacts > 0.
